subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.9 QQBot: long markdown reply is split into N independent bubbles (one per chunk), not a single message

question: Should QQBot preserve the current one-message-per-safe-Markdown-chunk behavior, or merge safe chunks into one QQ bubble when the combined payload fits a verified QQ API limit?
rationale: Current main intentionally sends complete Markdown chunks separately, an open PR proposes safe merging, and a member comment says the current behavior is by design; automation cannot choose the permanent channel UX policy.

options.title: Keep intentional chunking
options.body: Document that QQBot sends multiple complete Markdown messages to avoid truncation and close or reject merge-chunks PRs.

options.title: Merge verified-safe chunks
options.body: Refresh and land a narrow QQBot change that merges only within a live-verified byte limit and preserves split overflow behavior.

options.title: Compare both open PR shapes
options.body: Review the send-boundary PR and chunker-layer PR together before choosing where this policy should live.

recommendation.title: Keep intentional chunking
recommendation.body: Document that QQBot sends multiple complete Markdown messages to avoid truncation and close or reject merge-chunks PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: sliverp authored the central chunking work and has already given the by-design maintainer signal on this issue.
